fixed.problem: D3-10: every question got the same fast pass (Haiku, low effort, thinking off). Chat could not think longer or use a stronger model when a question needed it.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts: "'think it through: …' makes no fast call and runs the longer rung at once: fake-haiku at medium, thinking not off, 4096 tokens, CHAT_THOROUGH_RULES, no answer_thoroughly"; "the fast request carries answer_thoroughly with exactly its definition; many_records hands over at once (no ask) after one call"; "the role prompt sent is conversation-agent 1.4.0 with 'Thinking longer', on the fast and the thorough request"; plus the 'rungs follow the need' cases (best rung on opus, haiku ceiling)
fixed.how: New src/conversation/depth.ts holds the rungs, the word detection and every model-facing and person-facing text. There are three rungs. Longer: the same model one effort step up with adaptive thinking, 4,096 tokens a call, 8 calls, 120 s. Stronger: the new mode chat_thorough (sonnet, medium), held at the project's highest model and at max_effort. Best: the project's highest model, only on the person's words or a Go ahead. The rung is picked by the person's words at the start or end of a line (outside quotes), by the Think it through button (depth: "longer"), or by the fast model's one tool answer_thoroughly {why} (an enum). Code picks the model, the effort, the money and whether to ask. The thorough pass reuses the quick pass's facts and has 8,000 tokens of history, recall sizes 3,000/4,000, CHAT_THOROUGH_RULES, and the quick tools without answer_thoroughly. conversation-agent.md 1.4.0 adds a 'Thinking longer' section.
fixed.check_in_the_app: In a project with a failed task, ask in Chat: why does "<that task>" keep failing and what should I change? Under a short answer you see 'This needs a stronger model: about CHF … (at most CHF …) and … seconds. Go ahead?'. Press Go ahead: the answer names the cause and one next step, with 'Thought it through with Sonnet · … s · CHF …' under it. Type 'think it through: what did the last two sessions do?': it thinks longer on the same model without asking. Ask 'what is left?': you get a fast answer with no such line.

fixed.problem: D3-11: while a reply was being made, the person saw only 'Thinking…' and a disabled 'Sending…' button, whatever chat was doing.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/chat-depth.test.tsx: 'shows the step the daemon sends, Send becomes Stop with its consequence line, and Stop ends the answer with what it cost' and 'with fake timers the waiting bubble reads 'Thinking…', then the step, then ' · 3 s''; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-chat-depth, run C' > 'POST /chat/stream: a line that reads the last session gets the turn frame first, then the step 'Reading the last session…', then the tokens and the reply…'; apps/ui/e2e/chat.spec.ts 'the waiting line names the step, Send becomes Stop, and Stop ends the answer'
fixed.how: POST /chat/stream now sends a turn frame {turnId, startedAt} first, then a step frame {text, at, reset?} at each step, then tokens and the reply. Every frame write has a .catch, so a dropped stream never stops a turn. Command tools also say their step (withStep). In the UI, streamChat reads the new frames, and the store's live state keeps the turn id, step, start time and depth. The bubble shows 'Thinking…', then the newest step, then ' · N s' from 3 s on. /events sends conversation.changed, and Talk and the Chat tab read it again.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Ask 'what did the last session do?': the bubble says 'Reading the last session…' before the answer. During a longer answer it says 'Thinking it through with Sonnet: about … seconds, at most CHF ….' and the seconds count up.

fixed.problem: D3-12: an answer could not be stopped. There was no Stop and no route, and ChatRequest.signal never reached the run, so voice's barge-in did not stop the model call.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts: 'Stop while the stand-in holds a call ends the run as killed within a second, makes no further call, and the reply row says stopped with the call's booked cost' and 'the request's own signal (voice's barge-in) now reaches the run: aborted mid-call, the run ends as killed'; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'Stop on a held turn: {stopped: true}…; another person's Stop is 403; a finished turn's Stop is {stopped: false}; a dropped stream does not stop a turn…'
fixed.how: New ChatTurns registry (src/conversation/chat-turns.ts) keeps one entry per turn with its own AbortController. Every run of the turn gets AbortSignal.any([req.signal, controller.signal]). New routes: POST /chat/turns/:id/stop (another person gets 403, an ended turn gets {stopped:false}) and POST /chat/turns/:id/answer-now, which calls SessionBudget.wrapUpNow. The loop books the call that was cut off. A stopped reply keeps its complete sentences, and its footer is 'You stopped this answer: CHF … spent.'. In the UI, Send becomes Stop (with its consequence line in the title), and a longer answer also has Answer now.
fixed.check_in_the_app: During a longer answer, press Stop: the answer ends and 'You stopped this answer: CHF … spent.' is under it. During another one, press Answer now: it answers at once with what it found so far.

fixed.problem: D3-13 (money): nothing bounded what chat could spend per answer beyond ADR 0091's USD 0.25 per turn, and nothing asked before a more expensive model.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/chat-depth.test.ts: 'why failure: no stronger call; the model hears exactly the ask result, the answer ends with the ask line and Go ahead; nothing more is booked; a typed 'yes' runs it once', 'any other next line drops the offer with nothing spent', 'called after a task_get, the gate refuses (records read)…', 'a questions card listed in full whose quoted words ask for the best model: the hand-over is refused (records)…', 'the room below the pass's floor refuses with the cap line…', 'a chat credential that is not the person's first…asks and names it', 'with the person's amount at 0 the explicit longer pass asks first…', 'there is no daily sum…', 'the wrap-up reaches the thorough pass once and it still answers; the turn's ledger rows sum to the reply's cost', 'the estimate is the median of the last answers on that rung and model', 'the fast request's tools and system part are byte-identical whether the gate allows a hand-over or not', 'a Go ahead after the agent is composed again on the same store runs once'; packages/commands/test/commands.test.ts chat_ask_above cases; apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'GET /settings: 'Chat asks first' is CHF 0.10 unset…'
fixed.how: The gate is answer_thoroughly's execute. In order, it refuses: a spoken turn; a 'quick' line; a turn that read a record or made a lookup or command first (turn.recordsRead, including a card listed in full); outer room (the month cap or the project's budget, via CapChecker.room) below the pass's floor; no rung above the quick pass. Each refusal is an exact sentence the model hears. The ask rule: a switch of model, an estimate above the person's amount (new setting chat_ask_above, CHF 0.10 by default, 0 means always ask), or a credential that is not the person's first asks in one line with cost and time. Only Go ahead or a typed yes as the next line goes on; any other line drops the offer. Nothing is spent before the yes. Pass budget: min(the amount, 'at most', the room), or after a yes min(the line's 'at most', the room). 'At most' is twice the estimate, rounded up. The floor is three worst cases of the first call. The estimate is the median of the last 20 answers on that rung and model. There is no daily sum. A wrap-up is heard once, and every call is booked. Settings, Basics gains the 'Chat asks first' row.
fixed.check_in_the_app: In Settings, Basics, 'Chat asks first' reads CHF 0.10. Set it to 0, then type 'think it through: what did the last two sessions do?': you get the ask line with Go ahead instead of an answer, and nothing is spent until you press it. Type any other line: the offer goes away.

new_problems: apps/ui/test/sessions-tab.test.tsx 'says the count, the working session on top…' (d1109-sessions, not this area) depends on the time of day. In the hours after local midnight, a session started earlier is drawn as '15 Nov, 22:40 · …' and the test's /^\d\d:\d\d · …/ fails. Seen at 00:45 UTC on 2026-11-16 and again earlier in this run; it passes with TZ=Etc/GMT-12. Fix: pin the clock (vi.setSystemTime) or build the rows' startedAt from a fixed local noon.

The bench stand-in (testenv role-player) produces mechanics only. Its thorough answer is 'Thought it through after N lookups…', not a cause named from the run's report. The 'names the cause from the run's report' part of U-094 needs the live check with a real model.
notes_for_other_areas: New exports in packages/runtime/src/conversation/depth.ts: Rung, Depth, WHY_VALUES, rungOfWhy, depthWords, askLine, handOverStep, footerWords, stoppedWords, closerLookWords, capWords, CLOSED_WORDS, FAILED_WORDS, TIMEOUT_REPLY, ANSWER_THOROUGHLY_TOOL/DESCRIPTION, ASK_RESULT, notNowResult, NOT_NOW, CHAT_THOROUGH_RULES, CHAT_WRAP_UP, chfUp/chfSpent/atMostOf, DEFAULT_ASK_ABOVE_CHF.

New ChatTurns registry (src/conversation/chat-turns.ts), shared through ConversationDeps.turns. ConversationAgent.turnsOf() gives the daemon the registry for /events conversation.changed and the stop and answer-now routes.

ConversationDeps gains chatRoom(scope) → {usdMicro, level}|null and chatCredential() → {first:boolean, words}. C5 / d1109-cred-engine should replace compose's chatCredential (routed.peek against personOrderOf) with the credential policy. The owner's open question (should chat's spend count against the project's budget?) changes one place: drop the project's budget from compose's chatRoom.

ChatRequest gains onStep(line, {reset}), onTurn, depth: 'longer' and offer. ChatReply gains depth, footer and offer. The chat.reply row gains depth, passes, why, offer, capLine, closer, footer, footerFacts and stopped (readTranscript reads them).

api-types.ts (append only) adds ChatRequestBody.depth/offer, ChatOfferView, ChatTurnFrame, ChatStepFrame, ChatStopView, ChatAnswerNowView, ConversationTurnView reply depth/footer/offer plus interrupted/failed, ConversationView.answering, and DAEMON_ROUTES chatStop/chatAnswerNow. The fake daemon mirrors them, and __test/next-chat-turn holds a turn.
SSE frames on /chat/stream are now: turn, step (with optional reset), token, reply. Any test that asserts only token frames before reply must allow turn and step (daemon.test.ts was updated).
SessionBudget.wrapUpNow(runId) forces the wrap-up line on the next precheck; Answer now uses it.

The new mode chat_thorough is in MODE_DEFAULTS, MODE_VALUES, AGENT_SETTING_MODES, views MODE_LABELS ('Chat, thorough answers'), STANDARD_SPEED_MODES and commands MODE_LABELS. Whole-list tests of modes (performance 8 to 9 modes, run-settings modes) were re-baselined.

The settings_set definition gains its line last, and w15-chat's key-line count is now 22. settings-view adds the human.chat_ask_above row after the monthly cap, and SettingsPage BASIC_SETTING_KEYS / SETTING_KEYS append it. Settings now lists 23 rows in the fixtures (settings.test.tsx and palette.spec.ts).

The conversation tool list now includes answer_thoroughly after the read and recall tools on every quick typed turn. Whole-list tool tests and the chat-recall token bound (CR-9) subtract this area's measured growth, so re-baseline at merge if another area adds tools.
evals/registry/principals/conversation-agent.md is now 1.4.0 ('Thinking longer'). Sync it to forerunner-registry at release.

Suggested design text for §3.9/§6 and U-094's text are in the spec's u_entries. The live check needs 4 steps with a real model: the failure question's ask line and Go ahead, think it through on the same model, Stop, and reload.
